description: Send a message (new or reply) immediately. Only when the user explicitly asked to send; confirm recipients, subject and body with them first.

account.description: Mailbox to write from (email, alias or local part).

bcc.description: Bcc recipients, same format as "to". They are not shown to the other recipients.

html.description: Optional HTML version of the body.

reply_all.description: With reply_to_message_id and no "to": copy all original recipients.

reply_to_message_id.description: Reply in the thread of this message id.

to.description: Recipients: "a@x.com, Name <b@y.com>" or a list. Optional when replying.

name: send_email
title: Send an email
